What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `bearssl`: BearSSL at webcpp::crypto's pin: bearssl_hmac.h states constant time for br_hmac_outCT alone; br_hkdf_* (src/kdf/hkdf.c) calls br_hmac_out.
* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.
* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man7/EVP_KDF-HKDF.pod and EVP_KDF-PBKDF2.pod state no constant-time property.
* `sodium`: libsodium 1.0.22: its headers state constant time for comparisons (sodium/utils.h) alone, not for its hashing, key derivation and password hashing functions (crypto_generichash_*, crypto_shorthash_*, crypto_kdf_*, crypto_pwhash_*).

The default of `hkdf_extract` and `hkdf_expand`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `openssl`, `sodium` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `hkdf`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `bearssl`, `openssl`, `sodium` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
